content: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099685 Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the members selected to display as Featured Members of the website, to learn more about the process of setting up Featured Members, navigate to the following link: Featured Members on Homepage To edit these settings, navigate to: In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings Select Designs Settings Open The Homepage Tab Open The Module Select Content to Display select The Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider Option Visual Guide of the Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider 1. Featured Blog Article Slider This setting controls which post type is linked to this section of the homepage. 2. Use Thumbnail on Mobile This setting allows administrators to choose whether to display thumbnails on mobile devices. It is recommended to enable this option for better visual appeal on smaller screens. 3. Background Color The background color setting allows the customization of the slider's background color. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided. 4. Font Color This setting enables the customization of the font color for the slider. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided. 5. Hover/Active Background Color The hover/active background color setting allows the customization of the background color when an item in the slider is hovered over or active. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided. 6. Hover/Active Font Color This setting enables the customization of the font color when an item in the slider is hovered over or active. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided. 7. Articles List Position This setting controls the position of the articles list within the slider. Administrators can choose to display the list on the right or left side. 8. Hide On Mobile This setting allows administrators to choose whether the blog article slider should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
